description: This file defines a Perl controller class for managing FAQ entries in an admin interface, including actions for listing, creating, editing, and updating FAQs.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::FAQ
classes.description: Controller class for managing FAQ entries in the admin section, handling CRUD operations and rendering related views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of FAQs, including generating URLs for editing each FAQ and creating a new FAQ.

methods.name: new_faq
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new FAQ, setting URLs and template.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a specific FAQ by ID for further actions, or detaches with a not_found error if not found.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the FAQ editing form, setting URLs for the current FAQ.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles the update request for an FAQ, delegating to update_or_create.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new FAQ object and delegates to update_or_create for saving.

methods.name: update_or_create
methods.description: Sets FAQ columns from request parameters, updates or inserts the FAQ, and redirects to the edit page.
